PrivateType is a private, local push-to-talk dictation app for Windows. Hold a shortcut, speak, and release it to insert text into the field where dictation began—without cloud recognition or transcript history.

## Highlights

### Shared, verified model storage

- New installations store the speech model once in a per-user cache under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\PrivateType\models` so cache-aware PrivateType versions can reuse it.
- Concurrent PrivateType processes coordinate the download, preventing duplicate downloads of the same model.
- The model is verified against its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.
- Existing release folders and their models are left untouched. An existing v1.0.2 model is not migrated or deleted, so v1.0.3 may download the model once on first use.
- To keep the model inside this release folder instead, create an empty `app\models` directory before starting PrivateType for the first time.

### Correct Windows app identity

- Fixed the generic or incorrect icon that could appear for PrivateType windows on the Windows taskbar.
- Startup registration now follows the selected app version. The same or a newer version can take over automatically, while an older or unversioned copy asks before changing the registration.
- Obsolete startup registration from the earlier LiveDictation app identity is removed safely.

## Download and start

1. Download `PrivateType-1.0.3-win-x64.zip` and `PrivateType-1.0.3-win-x64.zip.sha256` below.
2. Verify the SHA-256 checksum.
3. Extract the complete ZIP into a writable folder.
4. Open `PrivateType 1.0.3` and double-click `PrivateType.exe`.
5. Approve the separate local speech-model download on first launch if the verified model is not already in the shared cache.

The model is not bundled in the ZIP. PrivateType downloads it directly from NVIDIA on Hugging Face and verifies its pinned size and SHA-256 hash before use.

## Requirements

- 64-bit Windows 10 or Windows 11
- A modern x64 CPU and at least 4 GB RAM; 8 GB or more is recommended
- About 2 GB free disk space for the portable app, model, and working room
- [Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable for Visual Studio 2015–2022 (x64)](https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x64.exe)

## Privacy

Speech recognition runs locally. PrivateType has no account, cloud-recognition fallback, telemetry, retained audio, or transcript history. Review diagnostic reports before sharing them because application diagnostics can still contain information about your computer environment.
